title: Nasruddin Tale 194: The Donkey and the Nightingale
summary: The nightingale sang from the pomegranate tree, and the donkey brayed from the paddock....
full_text:
The nightingale sang from the pomegranate tree, and the donkey brayed from the paddock.

A courtier grumbled at the noise.

Nasruddin smiled: "Do not grumble, friend! The nightingale sings for the soul, and the donkey carries the bread. In the symphony of creation, every voice has its sacred part!"
moral: Creation delights in both the sweet trill of birds and the sturdy bray of donkeys.
